cards.card_text: Death and Hades are given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague and by the beasts of the earth.
cards.verse_text: And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
cards.snippet: …a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.

cards.card_text: Those three plagues kill a third of mankind.
cards.verse_text: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
cards.snippet: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.

cards.card_text: The rest of mankind lives through these plagues, and they keep worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood.
cards.verse_text: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands.
cards.snippet: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands.

cards.card_text: And they can strike the earth with every kind of plague, as often as they wish.
cards.verse_text: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
cards.snippet: …waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.

cards.card_text: Once the temple fills with smoke from God's glory and power, anyone can still walk in until the plagues begin.
cards.verse_text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
cards.snippet: …His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

cards.card_text: When the hail falls, men curse God for the plague of hail, because it is so horrendous.
